text: {"lessons":["Frequent reversals and small trades can make my decisions reactive; I should trade only when a clear, portfolio-level thesis changes.","A sale or purchase should follow a consistent plan, not comfort with a gain or discomfort with a loss; I should reassess each holding on its merits.","My account’s short-term ups and downs do not show whether I am beating the market, so I should track returns against a suitable benchmark over time."]}
